description: Switch your Windows 11 host's default audio output device from any browser on the LAN
notes: audioremote runs in the notification area and keeps its own server alive.
Start it once and click the button in the window it shows: that registers
start-at-logon, allows LAN access, and copies the URL to open on your phone
Windows 11 only. The server must run in your physical console session, not
over RDP - audio endpoints belong to the interactive user.
